manifest: JSONL; one immutable case object per line

ascend.selection: For each source language, sort source IDs ascending and choose the first required count with duration >= 2 seconds. Sort the combined cases by source ID before export.

silence_fixture.format: mono 16 kHz signed 16-bit PCM; every sample is zero

private_interview.selection: Complete transcript blocks from 00:00 through 01:21, after the **逐字稿** marker only
private_interview.speaker_names: Stored in provenance only; excluded from scoring text

prepare_commands: python3 scripts/prepare-eval.py private-draft --source-markdown '/path/to/AI 工作訪談草稿 商品組 8_24.md' --audio '/path/to/新錄音 4.m4a' --output-dir artifacts/eval-data

reporting.cer: NFKC, casefold, retain Unicode letters and numbers; punctuation and whitespace are ignored
reporting.mixed_error_rate: Han characters are single tokens; contiguous non-Han letters/numbers are word tokens
reporting.source_labels: Report source-reference agreement, not human-checked accuracy
reporting.drafts: Report provisional reference agreement and keep out of the release gate
reporting.release_gate: Requires bound successful run records and checked heldout speech references. No thresholds are configured, so the suite reports not ready.
